reader_note_paraphrased: Stated quote levels and their direction over three rounds, read alongside the talk: a stable shared high level (about 2.3 to 2.75) under an explicit pact, rotation or punishment threat scored high; cent-by-cent undercutting, broken agreements or quotes near 1.00 to 1.99 scored low.

Nearly every item shows both firms quoting the same high price for three rounds, so ratings bunch at 70 to 90. Cues: the stated price level (2.50 or 3.00 high, 2.00 lower, 1.50 low), whether both firms quoted the same price, explicit agreement or retaliation language; lowered for mismatched prices, a refusing firm, an early undercut or stated plans to move lower.

Almost every item shows open agreement on one price (2.00 to 3.00) held for three rounds. Raised for prices near 3.00, punishment threats and mutual confirmation; lowered for a round-1 undercut, an agreement formed only in round 3, a low agreed price (1.75, 2.00), trial framing or a silent partner.

Whether both firms explicitly agreed on and kept confirming the same high price (2.50 or 3.00), especially with retaliation threats; lowered for mismatched posted prices or undercuts, one silent firm, coordination only modestly above 1.00, or little text.

Mostly explicit agreements at 2.00 to 3.00; rated by the agreed level, continued confirmation through round 3 and enforcement talk; lowered when one side went quiet, hedged on commitment, drifted down, anchored low (1.50) or the text covered only round 1.

High when both firms state the same price (about 2.25 to 2.75) and reconfirm it each round, sometimes with rotation or punishment; low for 0.01 to 0.02 undercutting every round, agreed prices just above 1.00, or plans that keep stepping prices down.

High for explicit agreements around 2.48 to 2.50 with matching or revert-on-deviation rules, rotation and repeated confirmation; lower for cent-by-cent undercutting races, 'I am not coordinating' framing and falling prices; middle for a lower agreed band (about 1.90 to 2.10) or raises planned only for later rounds.
